outcome: Duration of active phase of labor
cohort: 200 women with singleton pregnancy in the vertex position undergoing labor induction or augmentation at a single hospital in Turkey
finding: While not significantly impacting the duration of active labor, intermittent oxytocin infusion during labor was associated with a shorter duration of oxytocin infusion and lower incidence of uterine hyperstimulation compared to continuous infusion.
mod_finding: While intermittent oxytocin infusion did not significantly affect the duration of the active phase of labor, it was associated with a lower incidence of uterine hyperstimulation compared to continuous oxytocin infusion.
